_readme: GDD-sync queue for the Foundation ADRs. 'queue' = ADR-mandated text edits (old -> new) from the foundation-adrs workflow run 2; 'check' was measured 2026-10-28: OLD_PRESENT = still to apply, old_absent = re-anchor before applying, nofile = target not a single file. 'contradictions' = requirements whose GDD text contradicts a Proposed ADR (architecture review 2026-10-28); user ruling 2026-10-29: ADR wins, GDD-intent objections go to the user first. Consumed by plan .claude/plans/agile-dancing-snail.md Phase 2.
